features.title: Long-running background agents
features.note: Each live run is a child process in its own process group with an explicit env (only that run's key), per-run workspace; global os.environ no longer touched on the live path. deepseek_harness SDK is not installed here, so the real SDK is not exercised.

features.title: Agent handoff between local and cloud environments
features.note: HMAC-signed, expiring, single-use, team/run/target-bound manifests; secrets refused. No API route, transport, or durable replay set yet.

features.title: Follow-up messages to active runs
features.note: Bounded per-run inbox, once-only drain, secret rejection, closes with the run. Not yet wired to a route or injected at the engine boundary.

features.title: Pause, resume, and cancel controls
features.note: Stop/pause cancel the awaiting task; the child process group (incl. grandchildren) is SIGKILLed and no writes follow. Existing pause/resume state tests unchanged.

features.title: Automatic retry policy
features.note: Bounded exponential backoff, transient/permanent classification, idempotency ledger (replay never re-executes or re-bills). Not yet called from service._execute.

features.title: Failure recovery strategies
features.note: Deterministic bounded strategy choice (resume/retry/escalate/abort), never a model switch; atomic checkpoints. Not yet driving service recovery.

needs_integration: Prove SDK tool/edit/network hooks route through S5 authority (SDK not installed; live runs fail closed by default)

VR006: Signed handoff manifests + atomic checkpoints (library); not wired into service.
VR009: Per-run workspace under a confinement root with symlink/traversal refusal; git worktree-per-agent not implemented.
VR016: S2 instruction framing + follow-ups framed as data; live SDK tool confinement unproven so live runs fail closed unless ENGINE_ALLOW_UNCONFINED_LIVE=1.
VR023: CheckpointStore + retry idempotency ledger (library); not wired to _execute.
VR024: Killable process groups (no zombie spend), fair scheduler, idempotent retries.
VR025: Ask-mode now durable via PLAN_PROPOSED payload and restored on any replica; sticky against flips. Other multi-replica items untouched.
